audit.summary: The pinned greedy-diverse selector has an empty-dictionary invariant that removes the intended low-performing diversity half. Main-text, appendix and released voting rules are non-equivalent and can select different top-two output patterns. Exact equal-compute matching remains Needs Evidence. Historical benchmark damage and hidden-answer leakage are not established.
